title: InteroperabilityCertificationRecord
description: The canonical Layer-2 (Conformance & Interoperability Certification) verdict (ADR-034 D-064-03). Binds a CertifiedImplementation (by implementation_hash) to an InteroperabilityCertificationProfile (by profile_id+profile_version), carries the reproducible evidence hashes, the Rust-decided status + reason_code (ADR-035), the scope (never broader than the evidence), a validity window, and a record_hash over the whole. A CERTIFIED record asserts ONLY 'this implementation passed this profile version with this evidence, in this scope, until this date' — it is NOT a licence, NOT scheme admission and NOT regulatory authorisation (ADR-004). Decided solely by the Rust engine (banza-certification); no Qwen, no external model, no human FAIL->PASS.
_authority: ADR-034 (interoperability certification), ADR-036, ADR-035 (closed certification-state machine); this schema defines the record. engines/banza-certification implements it and does not define it.
_boundary: Technical certification of an implementation. Not a licence, scheme admission or regulatory authorisation. BANZA holds no funds and admits no participant.

implementation_hash.description: Content hash of the exact artifact set tested; the certificate binds to THIS hash.

status.description: Closed certification-state (ADR-035). Only CERTIFIED (within window, evidence reproduces) reads as valid; all others fail-closed.

scope_levels.description: Levels the verdict covers — never broader than the evidence.

conformance_report_hash.description: Reproducible evidence hash of the ConformanceReport.

interoperability_report_hash.description: Reproducible evidence hash of the InteroperabilityReport.

expires_at.description: UTC seconds; equals issued_at for a non-CERTIFIED record.

record_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 over the record excluding this field; must reproduce (ADR-034 D-064-05).

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
